study.question: Does the benefit of retaining same-event content in target-field conjunction summaries come from the four nondefining item fields, historical action, or an interaction between them, conditional on joint pair-defining content and joint counts?
study.hypothesis: The four nondefining item fields are the larger source of incremental benefit, while same-event historical-action content is smaller or redundant conditional on them. The latest partition pooled those distinct coordinates: other-only joint scored0.8313049451, defining-only joint0.8308077732, all-joint0.8314095191, and all-marginal0.8305072495. Thus other-field binding adds0.0006017459 with defining content joint, but includes action. Earlier direct feedback-binding did not beat its factorized control, making conditional item composition a testable, provisional explanation rather than an established mechanism. New hybrids retain all coordinates and replace only their information source.

study.proposed_difference: Three disjoint coordinate groups per pair: two defining item blocks always joint; four other item blocks switch joint/factorized; final historical-action block independently switches joint/factorized. Two torch.where selections implement the complete2x2 without subtract/re-add, new trainable parameters, new tokens or changed masks. Four standalone sources share the exact same implementation except literal architecture defaults. Two hybrid candidates and two replay controls isolate item and action binding plus their interaction. This is a local attribution refinement; originality remains unverified. Full-joint incumbent remains the supported performance choice until new host results exist.
predictions: Primary directional hypothesis: Y(J,F)>Y(F,J), where arguments are other-item/action content and Y is the fixed validation four-task macro AUC. More diagnostic conditional effects are D_item|A=F=Y(J,F)-Y(F,F) and D_item|A=J=Y(J,J)-Y(F,J); predict positive effects, with average item effect larger than average action effect. No minimum improvement or per-task veto is invented.

Action effects D_action|I=F=Y(F,J)-Y(F,F) and D_action|I=J=Y(J,J)-Y(J,F) are smaller; they may be null/negative. Report both even if the hybrid loses to full joint. Compute interaction Y(J,J)-Y(J,F)-Y(F,J)+Y(F,F); do not assume additivity.

Identical histories of nonzero length with all masks false must give zero pair update, and padded-ID/current-action perturbations must not change same-model outputs.
